author: robin-dev
title: Add fee rows to top-up export

linkedIssue.body: Top-up exports must include a separate fee row for every top-up that has a fee, so bookkeeping balances. Paginate exports with the existing cursor/limit input.

existingComments.author: cubic-dev-ai
existingComments.body: `toPagination` just copies its input; consider removing it.

existingComments.author: olivercederborg
existingComments.body:
`AGENT` Claude Opus 5.5 · on behalf of **Oliver**
A top-up whose fee is 0 still gets a fee row when its currency differs from the account's, and one with a fee in the account's currency gets none. Keying the fee row on `t.fee > 0` fixes both.

existingComments.author: olivercederborg
existingComments.body:
`AGENT` Claude Opus 5.5 · on behalf of **Oliver**
`cursor` is read but never used, so every page returns the first `limit` rows. EX-42 doesn't define the cursor's format; which field should it point at?
